legend: Architectural patterns of endocrine mucin-producing sweat gland carcinoma are shown, at low magnification. A dermal nodule with multinodular, cystic, solid, and papillary growth and scattered pools of sparse, light-blue stromal mucin is identified. The tumour cells look bland to uniform with bluish, amphophilic cytoplasm.

A higher magnification highlights the cyst wall mural thickenings. The tumour cells resemble bland eccrine ductal cells with moderately enlarged ovoid nuclei with stippled chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli, bluish cytoplasm, and intracellular and extracellular mucin. Note the incomplete myoepithelial rim.

diagnosis: Invasive mucinous carcinoma arising in endocrine mucin-producing sweat gland carcinoma
legend: Endocrine mucin-producing sweat gland carcinoma with invasive mucinous component, at low magnification. An expansile nodule with cystic and papillary growth and nests of tumour cells floating in copious, central extracellular mucin, signifying transformation to invasive mucinous carcinoma.
Lower-eyelid endocrine mucin-producing sweat gland carcinoma, showing a brown/bluish nodule.

legend: Tumour cells show diffuse nuclear staining for INSM1, a highly sensitive neuroendocrine marker for endocrine mucin-producing sweat gland carcinoma.
